# harmoniq_workspace_plan (Resource)

The plan of a workspace, with an optional trial and per-tenant overrides (PLN-01, PLN-06). Needs an instance API key (`hq_inst_…`, scope `instance:admin`). Destroying it puts the workspace back on `hobby` without overrides.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harmoniq_workspace_plan" "checkout_team" {
  provider          = harmoniq.instance
  workspace         = "checkout-team"
  plan              = "startup"
  feature_overrides = { saml = true }
  # -1 is unlimited.
  limit_overrides = { modules = 100, deploysPerMonth = -1 }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plan` (String) `hobby`, `startup` or `enterprise`.
- `workspace` (String) The workspace slug.

### Optional

- `base_plan` (String) With `expires_at`: the plan after the trial (default: the plan before the trial).
- `expires_at` (String) Makes `plan` a trial ending at this time (RFC 3339); the workspace then falls back to `base_plan`.
- `feature_overrides` (Map of Boolean) Features turned on or off whatever the plan: `byob`, `approvals`, `saml`, `scim`.
- `limit_overrides` (Map of Number) Quotas that differ from the plan's, `-1` for unlimited: `workspaces`, `members`, `modules`, `environmentsPerHostApp`, `storageGb`, `deploysPerMonth`, `webhooks`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The workspace slug.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import harmoniq_workspace_plan.checkout_team checkout-team
```
